quest.skyabyss.main_finale_ascend.title: Above the Clouds
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_ascend.summar: The moon's lid is gone. The pilgrim is coming down from above the sky.
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_ascend.done: The bell of the pilgrim gate rang. A road goes on beyond the clouds.
The moon's core stopped, yet the moon did not stop falling, and a winged shadow crossed it. The counting song must go on. Ask the storyteller.
Ask the storyteller about the song
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_ascend.ascend: The seventh verse is a song of the sky above. Touch the gate atop the bell tower. The sleeping titans are awake.
Touch the gate atop the great bell tower
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_ascend.bell.j: The titans carried you above the clouds. Under the broken pilgrim gate, a single bell remains.
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_ascend.bell.b: Ring the bell of the pilgrim gate
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.fin_verse:
...Did you hear it? That sound of wings.
The counting song's seventh verse. The last one. Even my grandmother sang this part quietly.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.fin_verse2:
"Seventh: open your eyes, and choose of the two."
Open your eyes and choose one of two, it says. It never sings what you choose.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.fin_verse3: Go to the gate atop the bell tower. ...The great ones who slept have been looking at the sky since last night. They're waiting for you, I'd say.
message.skyabyss.cloudsea.fell: You nearly fell beneath the clouds, and found yourself back on the island.
message.skyabyss.cloudsea.gate: The bell's sound carried far across the sea of clouds.
message.skyabyss.cloudsea.arrive.title: The Cloud Sea
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_bell.title: The Isle of Bells
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_bell.summary: A fragment of the former city floats above the clouds.
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_bell.done: The bellkeeper's shadow returned to the sound of the bell.
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_bell.walk.jou: From the north of the pilgrim gate's isle, a white bridge climbs above the clouds.
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_bell.bells.jo: A street you know. The former city. Three bells remain on the fragments around it. When a bell rings, the nearby clouds turn solid.
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_bell.bells.w: Ring the bell on the west fragment
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_bell.bells.e: Ring the bell on the east fragment
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_bell.bells.n: Ring the bell on the northwest fragment
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_bell.door.jou: Three bells have rung. The door of the broken bell tower in the north answered with a dull toll.
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_bell.lord.jou: Someone stands atop the bell tower, carrying a bell.
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_bell.lord.lor: Lay the last bellkeeper to rest
message.skyabyss.isle1.bell.w: The bell at the ruined chapel rang.
message.skyabyss.isle1.door.shut: The door won't move. The bells on the fragments have not rung yet.
message.skyabyss.isle1.echo.w: Someone's last words remained at the ruined chapel.
message.skyabyss.isle1.echo.e: Someone's last words remained at the market stall.
message.skyabyss.isle1.echo.n: Someone's last words remained by the well.
lore.skyabyss.finale.bell_echo_1.title: The Chapel Apprentice
lore.skyabyss.finale.bell_echo_1.body:
On the morning the sky turned white, the apprentice kept ringing the bell. The master said, "No one will come, however you ring."

The apprentice did not stop. Not for anyone coming, but to tell the sky that a city had been here.

Even when the clouds rose to their feet, the bell's sound hardened the clouds and kept the apprentice standing to the end.
lore.skyabyss.finale.bell_echo_2.title: The Market Seller
lore.skyabyss.finale.bell_echo_2.body:
The market seller opened the stall on the last day too, not knowing what to sell to what came down from the sky.

"I feel there was a morning like this before," a customer said. The seller laughed and handed over an apple at the usual price.

The last line of the ledger is blank. The sky came before it could be written.
lore.skyabyss.finale.bell_echo_3.title: The Well Keeper
lore.skyabyss.finale.bell_echo_3.body:
The well keeper looked up at the sky with the bucket still lowered, and saw the shadow of wings pass over the clouds.

"The bellkeeper climbed the tower with the bell on his back. He never came down."

There is still water at the bottom of the well, though no one draws it.
message.skyabyss.isle1.lord_silence: The bellkeeper raises a hand to its mask, and the bells fall silent; the cloud ring unravels. Ring the small bells around you to firm it again.
message.skyabyss.isle1.lord_wave: The bell wave caught your feet. Jump as the ring passes.
message.skyabyss.isle1.lord_crumble: Half the floor crumbles into cloud.
message.skyabyss.isle1.lord_down: The last bellkeeper's great bell slowly falls silent. Every bell on the island answers it, once.
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_lamp.title: Isle of the Lamp
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_lamp.summary: From atop the bell tower, a bridge of light runs down to the next isle.
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_lamp.done: The lamp-keeper's eye has closed. The lamp is only a lamp again.
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_lamp.walk.jou: A bridge of pale gold light runs down from the north edge of the bell tower, toward an isle of sand with a leaning lighthouse.
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_lamp.lamps.jo: The lighthouse beam sweeps the isle. Caught in it, your body grows heavy; rocks and walls hide you. Three dead fishing lamps stand at the ends of the jetties.
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_lamp.door.jou: The three lamps are lit. The lighthouse door unlatches with a click.
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_lamp.lord.jou: Atop the lighthouse, an eye in a cage is watching you.
message.skyabyss.isle2.caught: The beam has found you. Your body is heavy. Get behind a rock or a wall.
message.skyabyss.isle2.lamp.w: The west jetty lamp is lit.
message.skyabyss.isle2.lamp.e: The east jetty lamp is lit.
message.skyabyss.isle2.lamp.s: The southeast jetty lamp is lit.
message.skyabyss.isle2.door.shut: The door will not open. The jetty lamps are not yet lit.
message.skyabyss.isle2.echo.w: At the foot of the west jetty, someone's last words remain.
message.skyabyss.isle2.echo.e: At the foot of the east jetty, someone's last words remain.
message.skyabyss.isle2.echo.s: At the foot of the southeast jetty, someone's last words remain.
message.skyabyss.isle2.netted: A wet net has you tangled. When a net caster swings its net, get out of the fan.
message.skyabyss.isle2.marked: The moth's light clings to you. For a while, the beam will find you even in shadow.
message.skyabyss.isle2.lord_stare: The eye's light pierced you. When the thread narrows, get behind a pillar.
message.skyabyss.isle2.lord_down: The eye in the cage slowly closes. The light that swept the isle turns, at last, out to sea.
message.skyabyss.cloudsea.bridge_shut: The light bridge will not carry you yet. Calm this isle's lord first.
area.skyabyss.finale_lamp_arena.sub: Where it watched a sea no one returned from
lore.skyabyss.finale.lamp_echo_1.title: The Net-Master's Daughter
lore.skyabyss.finale.lamp_echo_1.body:
On the morning no boat came home, the daughter looked up at the lighthouse from the shore.

The lamp was not lighting the sea. It was lighting the sky. Only the lighthouse watched the sea rise into it.

"Is Father's boat up there too?" She folded the nets and walked toward the turning light.
lore.skyabyss.finale.lamp_echo_2.title: The Lamp-Keeper's Apprentice
lore.skyabyss.finale.lamp_echo_2.body:
My master said: "A lamp is for watching. If you keep watching, someone comes home."

Even as the shore was lifted into the sky, he would not leave the lamp room. Close your eyes, he said, and the way home disappears.

The last time I saw him, his eye was the color of the lamp. It has not closed since.
lore.skyabyss.finale.lamp_echo_3.title: The Child at Hide-and-Seek
lore.skyabyss.finale.lamp_echo_3.body:
Caught by the lamp, you're it. The shore children played at fleeing the turning light into the shadows of the rocks.

That day the light turned slower than usual. The grown-ups were all looking at the sky, and no one took a turn as it.

The child waited behind the rock a long time. "Ready." No one has answered yet.
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_forge.title: Isle of the Forge
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_forge.summary: From atop the lighthouse, a bridge of light runs down to an isle of ash.
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_forge.done: The rewinder's wheel has stopped. The forge fire moves forward again.
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_forge.walk.jo: A bridge of light runs down from the lighthouse to an ash-grey isle. A great forge sends up smoke.
On this isle, what happens happens again. The broken bridges rewind and return for a moment. Where a blow lands, it lands again a little later. Three cold forges wait on the fragments.
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_forge.door.jo: The three forges burn. The heat loosens the bar on the great forge's door.
quest.skyabyss.main_finale_forge.lord.jo: Atop the great forge, a smith with a wheel on his back strikes the same blow again and again.
message.skyabyss.isle3.door.shut: The door is cold and will not move. The fragments' forges are not yet lit.
message.skyabyss.isle3.echo.w: In the bellows yard, someone's last words remain.
message.skyabyss.isle3.echo.e: In the casting yard, someone's last words remain.
message.skyabyss.isle3.echo.n: In the coal yard, someone's last words remain.
message.skyabyss.isle3.echo_first: Embers linger where the blow fell. The same spot will be struck again in a moment. Move away.
message.skyabyss.isle3.lord_prints: Ember marks glow under your feet. Where you stand will burn. Move.
message.skyabyss.isle3.lord_ring: The outer ring crumbles and begins to rewind. When the ember outline glows, the stone returns.
message.skyabyss.isle3.lord_twice: The wheel spins faster. Every blow now comes back twice.
message.skyabyss.isle3.lord_down: The rewinder's wheel stops and the embers in its cracks go out. For the first time, the great forge burns forward.
area.skyabyss.finale_forge_arena.sub: Where the same blow falls again
lore.skyabyss.finale.forge_echo_1.title: The Bellows Boy
lore.skyabyss.finale.forge_echo_1.body:
Push the bellows and the forge breathes. Stop and it stops. That was all the boy was taught.

The day the sky drew near, the grown-ups stopped and looked up. Only the boy kept pushing. He felt that if he stopped, everything would.

You can still hear it. Push, draw back, push again.
lore.skyabyss.finale.forge_echo_2.title: The Mold-Maker
lore.skyabyss.finale.forge_echo_2.body:
Iron poured into a mold sets only as the mold allows. So you carve the mold as the inside-out of what you want.

In her last mold, the mold-maker carved nothing. "Let the people of the next world pour in what shape they like."

The empty mold is still buried in the sand.
lore.skyabyss.finale.forge_echo_3.title: The Master Smith's Note
lore.skyabyss.finale.forge_echo_3.body:
A botched blow can be struck again. While the iron is hot, it always comes back. That is what I taught my apprentices.

But this time the botch is the world itself. I will strike it again. As many times as it takes, from the same place.

...If I find I cannot stop striking it again, someone, stop me.
